title: Sir Thomas - Talk Wet
htmlContent:
Sir Thomas brings an exciting experience full of appeal on the new song “Talk Wet”. The sound is mega with a global appeal that shines, on this record filled with amazing colors with the waves of the music, sweeping the listener away. The vocal performance is big time with a daring energy that is commanding enough to guide the listener, over this amazing record that delivers in every single facet of record making to the fullest.
